name: custom4-pcie-h100-cal
description: Calibrated 4x H100 PCIe node fabric (hardware validation, 2026-09-26): ring-only PCIe graph (the GPU2-GPU3 NVLink bridge cannot serve a ring), 17.3 GiB/s per direction (NCCL all-reduce plateau), 300 ns effective hop and a 24 us collective launch floor (nccl-tests at 8 B), persistent channels (-preconnected), receiver-side completion (--recv-flow-finish), 4 MiB dataset splits (max 16) with 2 in flight, a 3 us per-step latency once a step's chunk reaches 64 KiB (NCCL's LL -> Simple protocol switch) and plateau efficiencies relative to all-reduce of all-gather 0.93, reduce-scatter 0.945, all-to-all 0.865. Against the clean nccl-tests run on htc-g055 (job 8895380), at the sizes where two NCCL runs agree within 5 %: mean |error| 4.8 % all-reduce, 2.8 % all-gather, 5.4 % reduce-scatter, 3.4 % all-to-all; all-reduce within +-3 % from 512 KiB to 2 GiB; outliers are the <= 2 KiB floor (-9..-14 %) and 32 KiB (+11 %, packet quantisation).
